name: Call of Water
summary: Swart sends a shaman from Razor Hill to seek Islen Waterseer on the Barrens coast. Earth and fire have tested the initiate; now water calls for a different kind of understanding.

sections.title: A Shift in the Elements
sections.body: Swart, the shaman trainer in Razor Hill, guides initiates through the elements. Earth has taught them endurance, and fire has tested their command. Once a shaman proves they can wield flame without being consumed by it, Swart judges them ready to seek the teachings of water.

sections.title: The Recluse of the Merchant Coast
sections.body: Islen Waterseer lives on the Barrens coast, beyond Ratchet. To reach her, travel south along the Southfury River into the Barrens, then head east to the shore near a massive shark's carcass. Islen dwells where the waves meet the land, apart from the trainers in Durotar's towns. She guides the Horde in communion with water.

faq.answer: Swart, the orc shaman trainer in Razor Hill, sends you onward after you prove your command of earth and fire.

faq.q: Where can I find Islen Waterseer?
faq.answer: Islen Waterseer lives on the eastern coast of the Barrens, just south of Ratchet. Follow the Southfury River south from Durotar, then head for the shore and look for her camp beside a large beached shark.

faq.q: Why must a shaman learn the elements in a specific order?
faq.answer: Shamanic tradition asks an initiate to build spiritual balance step by step. Earth grounds the soul, and fire tempers it for water's shifting nature.

faq.q: Is this quest available to other classes?
aliases: is call of water shaman only
faq.answer: No. Shamans alone seek the favor of the water spirits and seek to manifest their Water Totem.

faq.q: What landmark should I look for when searching for Islen?
faq.answer: Look for a massive beached shark on the shore south of Ratchet. Islen lives beside it.

faq.q: What happens after reaching Islen Waterseer?
faq.answer: Speaking with Islen begins the trials of water. The shaman must travel across Kalimdor and Lordaeron, gather pure drops of water, and confront spirits before earning the totem.

angles.text: As a shaman, you turn from earth and fire toward water's restorative power, opening a spiritual path to healing totems.
As a Horde shaman, you are directed to Islen Waterseer on the Barrens coast to undertake your communion with water.
